title: Default acceptance-oracle bindings for generated screens
description: DDE-069 closes the DDE-068 carry-over: a generated screen receives its visual-verification bindings automatically, so the promotion guarantee stops being conditional on somebody remembering to attach one. DDE-068 proved that a bound check is machine-gated at promotion; this policy is what makes the binding exist. Versioned and inspectable here rather than buried in frontend constants (FRONTEND_STUDIO_REV3 section 42). Raising policy_version is a Project Truth change: it alters what every future generated screen is held to.
authority: docs/truth/FRONTEND_STUDIO_REV3.md section 20 (DDE-068 as the quality backplane); EDR-0016; EDR-0017

generated_screen.description: Any screen authored through a DDE generation or Frontend Studio authoring path. These bindings are mandatory: the binder refuses to author an oracle for such a screen without them.

rationale.silhouette: Deterministic, model-free near-match refusal against the generic-layout corpus. Cheap, and it catches the template-clone failure before any model is spent.
rationale.visual_critique: The rubric-scored multimodal judgment EDR-0016 requires. Any dimension below 4 blocks promotion; a critic that is unavailable or malformed fails closed rather than passing.
rationale.visual_diff: Only meaningful once an approved golden image exists for the screen, so it is optional rather than mandatory; binding it without a golden would fail closed on every run for the wrong reason.

imported_screen.description: A screen adopted from an external or donor source. Held to the same visual bar as a generated one, because provenance does not make pixels good.

rationale.silhouette: An imported template is the single most likely source of a generic-layout near-match.
rationale.visual_critique: Adoption is not evidence of quality.
